samuhia.name: SAMUHIA
samuhia.note: Master brand. Keeps the node triangle already in your site header (amber apex, two mint nodes) but makes it bolder and simpler. Three connected nodes = the ecosystem. Dark tile matches the hero.

mychama.name: MyChama
mychama.note: Two joined rings = the group; the overlap is amber (shared money); the forward arrow is disciplined growth. Uses the product colour from your site.

payments.name: Samuhia
payments.note: One continuous S of two opposing arcs: money in, money out. Amber-brown is your Payments colour; the second arc borrows the master green.

desk.name: Samuhia
desk.note: Shield plus crosshair for trusted, secure digital services. Blue is your Desk colour; the amber centre dot is the shared spark.

plot-yangu.name: Plot Yangu
plot-yangu.note: A simple house with an amber door: “my plot”, my property. Plain outline so it stays readable at favicon size.

myregister.name: MyRegister
myregister.note: A register sheet with a tick and attendance lines: exactly what teachers and parents see. Red is your MyRegister colour.
